page.overview:
Who is Guildivain Sailmet?

Guildivain Sailmet also known as Faldrinet, is a non-player character in Final Fantasy XIV, and is the main antagonist of the Sage questline.

Faldrinet studied the art of somonautics and became a Sage eventually falling in love with the Viera woman known as Hatia, another Sage from Psysis Technon. Eventually over time his lover became ill from an incurable disease and died within a week. Wracked with grief, Faldrinet fell to madness seeking ways to enhance and cure all illnesses through any means necessary. He used human test subjects in a procedure sought to enhance the body in order to cure them of their illness. Unfortunately, many lost their lives and those that live suffered through the symptoms of the enhancements and the mental trauma of being the only survivors. Rumors abound of his experiments, and he covered up his tracks in Sharlayan before heading off to Eorzea.

Faldrinet traveled to the town of Idyllshire, where he sought to obtain some muscmaloi from Saint Mocianne's Arboretum before he was cornered by Loifa, Ancel, and Mahaud. Before his attackers could do any harm, he dodges one of Loifa's spells, and before Mahaud could hit him with a more potent spell, the Warrior of Light jumps in front of him but is protected by Loifa with Haima. Afterwards Ancel states that there are too many prying eyes and teleports away, threatening them to not get in their way again. They aid the man, learning that his name is Faldrinet from Sharlayan, traveling the realm to heal those in need with the sage art. Lalah questions him to investigate what his attackers motives are and where they planned to head next, learning that they are going to Saint Mocianne's Arboretum for certain herbs. Faldrinet notices the Warrior is a sage not from Sharlayan, and after being told they were chosen by the crystal he is at a loss for words, knowing that the crystal belonged to his former lover. He denies something is amiss and states he will once again travel the realm..|name=Sage's Focus}}

Faldrinet travels to Central Thanalan to meet with an apothecary for the herbs instead, but during his transaction Loifa and the others appear to attack him once more. Before anything happens, Lalah and the Warrior show up once again stepping in. Loifa states how he regrets sparing the adventurers life and Lalah questions why they would do such things against good natured souls. Loifa states that they are just fools believing whatever they're told, and he asks Faldrinet about the weight of his sins. Faldrinet states how he fights against the fate of unfortunate souls dying without reason and he fights against this injustice. Loifa enlarges an Antling, as it approaches to attack Faldrinet, he provokes Ancel, causing Loifa's compatriots to lose control and fall to the ground. Faldrinet lures the Antling away and Lalah stays behind to handle the current situation while the adventurer assists Faldrinet..|name=Sands of Despair}}
